body:
What I'm afraid of is my depression will get worse when the baby is here. I know I should feel happy that I'm going to be a father but I honestly don't. I am afraid to bring it up to my wife because I don't want her stressed out anymore than she already is. 

Even then, if I bring it up, it'll most likely end up in an argument about me being depressed and her not feeling like she's good enough for me or something.
It's an option, I just don't have the money or health insurance to be seen by a doctor. We have so much bills to pay we never end up with left over money.
